our_interpretation: Five years is measured from June 2, 2026, giving a June 2, 2031 comparison date.
As much is read as no material reduction, rather than exact equality to the cent.
The comparison concerns the same rack generation and configuration at comparable utilization and service levels, not the cost per token of newer hardware.
The unfinished-facility comparison holds location, remaining construction scope and required power capacity comparable.
The ordinary reading uses nominal costs in the same currency. Currency, inflation treatment and accounting basis are not specified.
I apply the five-year comparison to both clauses. No separate requirement that the bubble first burst is stated in this sentence.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable June 2031 records show no material reduction from June 2026 in both rack running costs and the costs of completing and powering comparable unfinished facilities.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable June 2031 records show materially lower running costs for the specified racks or materially lower completion and power-provision costs for comparable unfinished facilities. Divergent results across components would require a mixed assessment.
